name: c-necessary-ordinary
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name LIMIT 200

name: c-necessary-ordinary-repeat
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name LIMIT 200

name: c-necessary-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name LIMIT 200

name: c-necessary-distinct-repeat
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' AND n.id >= 0 RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class AS caller, n.caller_name AS name LIMIT 200

name: d-unbounded-android
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.graphId = 'fixture-android-00' AND n.caller_name = 'getTopMostActivity' RETURN [n.caller_class, n.caller_name] AS value

name: d-unbounded-kotlin
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.graphId = 'fixture-kotlin-compiler-00' AND n.caller_name = 'getName' RETURN [n.caller_class, n.caller_name] AS value

name: e-generic-ordinary
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toString(toString(n.caller_name)) CONTAINS 'get' RETURN [n.caller_class, n.caller_name] AS value LIMIT 20

name: e-generic-distinct
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE toString(toString(n.caller_name)) CONTAINS 'get' RETURN DISTINCT [n.caller_class, n.caller_name] AS value LIMIT 20
